title: Save the date: our Halloween party is on Saturday 31 October
preheader: Free entry, fancy dress and the bar open until midnight. Four weeks to plan the costume.

data.heading: Four weeks to plan the costume
body: Our Halloween party is back. Music all night, the bar open until midnight, and a room full of people who have made an effort. This is the one night of the year worth planning an outfit for, so consider this your notice.
Entry is free and there is nothing to pay. Let us know you are coming so we know how busy to expect it.

buttons.label: Let us know you are coming

image.alt: The House of Horrors Halloween party at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

rows.label: Fancy dress
rows.value: Encouraged, every level of effort welcome

rows.label: Food
rows.value: Full menu 12pm to 6pm, then pizza from 9pm

data.heading: Why we are telling you now
body: Halloween is our busiest night of the year, and the best costumes are the ones people started thinking about in September. Get your group together while everyone is still free.
We will send the details again nearer the time, so there is nothing you need to remember.

data.body: Put it in the diary, tell us you are coming, then go and think about the costume.
data.cta_label: Let us know you are coming

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
